title: NC Medicaid application for health coverage (DHB-5200)

fields.name: 1 First name Middle name Last name  Suffix
fields.label: 1. First name, Middle name, Last name & Suffix
fields.question: What is your full legal name, including your middle name and suffix, as it appears on official documents?

fields.name: 2 Home address Leave blank if you dont have one
fields.label: 2. Home address (Leave blank if you don't have one)
fields.question: What is your home address? The form itself says to leave this blank if you don't have one.

fields.name: 8 Mailing Address if different from home address
fields.label: 8. Mailing Address (if different from home address)
fields.question: What mailing address should the agency use if your mail goes somewhere different from your home address?

fields.name: 14 Phone Number
fields.label: 14. Phone Number
fields.question: What phone number can the agency use to reach you?

fields.name: 3 Date of Birth mmddyyyy
fields.label: 3. Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy):
fields.question: What is this person's date of birth, in the mm/dd/yyyy format the form prints?

fields.name: 5 Social Security Number SSN
fields.label: 5. Social Security Number (SSN):
fields.question: What is this person's Social Security number, if they have one? The form's note explains when it is needed and how to get help obtaining one.

fields.name: undefined_10
fields.label: Wages/tips (before taxes)
fields.question: About how much are you paid in wages or tips, before taxes, each time you get paid at your current job?

fields.name: Your total income next year if you think it will be different
fields.label: Your total income next year if you think it will be different
fields.question: If your total income next year will be different from what it is now, about how much will it be?
